summary: Iteration 5 — Frontend-only verification of the PhaseBadge/checkbox overlap fix on the admin home (orders list). Logged in as admin@somnio.co via demo chip, entered SELECT mode (testID enter-select-mode), and measured bounding boxes on the first 3 order cards. The PhaseBadge and order-checkbox-<id> now sit in a vertical stack inside orderRightCol with the checkbox cleanly BELOW the badge — phase y=563,h=17 (bottom=580); checkbox y=592,w=22,h=24 → ~12px gap, y-center delta 32.5px (>>4 threshold), both elements non-zero size and in-viewport for visible cards. No overlap detected. Selected SMN-EEE5CE6D and SMN-606E665B; checkbox icon visibly flipped to filled (orderCardSelected border highlights the cards); bulk-delete bar showed 'MOVE 2 TO BIN'. Confirm dialog accepted → both orders disappeared from the active home list. Recycle Bin (ATELIER · RECYCLE BIN, testID recycle-bin-button) listed both with order_ref, jewelry_name (TEST_new piece / TEST_other), 'Deleted 25 Jun 2026, 18:47 CST by admin@somnio.co' attribution, and Restore/Purge buttons. Tapped restore-SMN-EEE5CE6D → it left the bin; restored restore-SMN-606E665B as well to keep demo data intact; both back on the home active list after returning. No deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usage on this screen; no red-screen errors; only one harmless RNW warning ('props.pointerEvents is deprecated').
action_items: No fixes required. The PhaseBadge/checkbox overlap bug is resolved — the orderRightCol vertical stack with gap=6 correctly places the checkbox under the PHASE tag with both fully visible and non-overlapping.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/(app)/index.tsx:318-332 OrderCard right column refactor is clean: <View style={styles.orderRightCol}> wraps PhaseBadge (first child) and the conditional checkbox (second child). No absolute positioning, no zIndex tricks, no overflow risk — pure flex column with gap=6 and alignItems='flex-end'. This is the right fix.

frontend/app/(app)/index.tsx:426-433 styles.cardCheckbox uses marginTop:6 + alignItems:'flex-end' and orderRightCol uses alignItems:'flex-end' + gap:6 — slightly redundant (marginTop and gap both add vertical spacing), so the actual gap is 12px. Cosmetically fine but consider dropping cardCheckbox.marginTop to rely solely on the parent gap for consistency.

Checkbox icon (22x24px) is below the 44x44 touch-target minimum, BUT the whole row is the TouchableOpacity (line 302), so the effective hit area is the entire order card. This is correct mobile UX — no fix needed.

No regressions detected on bulk-delete (api.bulkSoftDeleteOrders), listRecycleBin, or restoreOrder integrations. The home list refresh after delete/restore correctly reflects the new state without manual reload.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 7 spec steps passed: login, SELECT mode, no overlap (3/3 cards), multi-select, MOVE 2 TO BIN, recycle bin listing with attribution, restore round-trip)

seed_data_creation: None. The two soft-deleted orders (SMN-EEE5CE6D, SMN-606E665B) were restored at end of test so demo data is intact. Active count returned to 10.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The OrderCard right column is now a vertical flex stack (PhaseBadge → checkbox). Any future change that re-introduces absolute positioning or removes orderRightCol must be re-tested for overlap. Bulk-delete flow uses window.confirm-style dialog on web; Playwright must register a page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) handler BEFORE clicking [data-testid='bulk-delete'].
